summary: Found one verified defect. Both existing tests pass; focused Python -B verification reproduces the regression. No project files were modified.

findings.evidence: The patch replaces the final-attempt raise with continue. With a publisher that always raises TransientError, baseline.py propagates the final exception after three calls; app.py returns None. README.md explicitly requires final-error propagation.
findings.consequence: Exhausted publishing failures become silent returns, preventing callers from observing and handling the failed operation.
